title: Successor pair update
statement: For natural numbers $A$, $B$, and $N$, define a statement that first increments $B$ by $1$. It then tests whether the updated value of $B$ equals $N$; if so, it sets $B$ to $0$ and increments $A$ by $1$, and otherwise does nothing further.
